features.name: Fisticuffs
features.entriesHtml:
Your years of fighting in back alleys and taverns have given you mastery over combat styles that use Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes and Pugilist weapons, which are the following:

  • Simple Melee Weapons|items|type=simple weapon;melee weapon=sand
  • Improvised Weapons|XPHB

You gain the following benefits while you are unarmed or wielding only Pugilist weapons and you are wearing Light or no armor and are not wielding a Shield.

Bonus Unarmed Strike.

You can make an Unarmed Strike|XPHB as a Bonus Action|XPHB.

Fisticuffs Die.

You can roll 1d8 in place of the normal damage of your Unarmed Strike|XPHB or Pugilist weapons. This die changes as you gain Pugilist levels, as shown in the Fisticuffs column of the Pugilist Features table.

Improved Improvisation.

Your talent for turning everything into a weapon allows you to use the mastery properties of Improvised Weapons|XPHB. All Improvised Weapons count as having the Sap|XPHB mastery property for you.

features.name: Iron Chin
features.entriesHtml: While you are wearing Light or no armor and not wielding a Shield, your base Armor Class|XPHB equals 12 plus your Constitution modifier.

features.name: Bloodied But Unbowed
features.entriesHtml:
When you take damage, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to regain all your expended Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Points. If you are Bloodied|XPHB when you take this Reaction|XPHB, you also gain Temporary Hit Points|XPHB equal to four times your Pugilist level. These Temporary Hit Points|XPHB vanish if any remain when you finish a Short Rest|XPHB.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

features.name: Moxie
features.entriesHtml:
Your experiences of beating the odds have given you a moxie you can channel in the midst of battle. This swagger is represented by a number of Moxie Points. Your Pugilist level determines the maximum number of points you have, as shown in the Moxie Points column of the Pugilist Features table.

You can spend these points to enhance or fuel certain Pugilist features. You start knowing three such features: Brace Up, One-Two Punch, and Stick and Move, each of which is detailed below.

When you expend a Moxie Point, it is unavailable until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB, at the end of which you regain all your expended points.

Brace Up.

You can use a Bonus Action|XPHB and expend 1 Moxie Point to brace for attacks. When you do so, roll your Fisticuffs die, and gain a number of Temporary Hit Points|XPHB equal to the number rolled plus your Pugilist level and your Constitution modifier. These Temporary Hit Points|XPHB vanish if any remain after 10 minutes.

One-Two Punch.

You can expend 1 Moxie Point to make two Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes as a Bonus Action|XPHB.

Stick and Move.

You can use a Bonus Action|XPHB and expend 1 Moxie Point to make an Unarmed Strike|XPHB and take the Dash or Disengage action.

features.name: Swagger Streak
features.entriesHtml: When you fail a Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma check, you can expend a Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Point to attempt to swagger your way to success. Roll your Fisticuffs die and add the number rolled to the ability check, potentially turning it into a success. If the ability check still fails, you regain the expended Moxie Point and can't use this feature again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

features.name: Heavy Hitter
features.entriesHtml: When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB, you can use both the Damage and your choice of the Grapple or Shove option.

features.name: Pugilist Subclass
features.entriesHtml: You gain a Pugilist subclass of your choice. A subclass is a specialization that grants you features at certain Pugilist levels. For the rest of your career, you gain each of your subclass's features that are of your Pugilist level or lower.

features.entriesHtml: You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your choice for which you qualify.

features.name: Dig Deep
features.entriesHtml:
You can use a Bonus Action|XPHB to dig deep. For 10 minutes, you have Resistance|XPHB to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage and you ignore the effects of Exhaustion levels less than 6.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB unless you gain 1 Exhaustion level (no action required by you) to restore your use of it.

features.name: Haymaker

features.name: School of Hard Knocks
features.entriesHtml:
Once per turn, you can deal an extra 1d12 damage when you hit with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB or attack with a Pugilist weapon. This damage is the same type dealt by the weapon or Unarmed Strike|XPHB. You can forgo this extra damage to apply one of the following effects.

Endanger.

The next time the creature is hit by an attack, the attack deals the maximum result of the attack's damage dice rather than rolling.

Provoke.

The creature has Disadvantage|XPHB on attack rolls against creatures other than you until the end of your next turn.

Pillar Breaker.

Unmatched Athlete.

Your jump distance is doubled.

features.name: Shake It Off
features.entriesHtml:
With unflappable resolve, you can remove one of the following conditions from yourself at the start of each of your turns: Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, one level of Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Poisoned, Restrained, or Stunned.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB unless you take a level of Exhaustion (no action required by you) to restore your use of it.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

features.name: Peak Physical Condition
features.entriesHtml:
Your strength and resilience are the stuff of legends. You gain the following benefits.

Hale and Hearty.

Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 2, to a maximum of 23.

Sleep It Off.

When you finish a Long Rest|XPHB and you have the Exhaustion condition, you lose all levels of Exhaustion.

Vim and Vigor.

When you finish a Short Rest|XPHB, you regain Hit Points|XPHB equal to twice your Pugilist level.

features.name: Brawler's Best Friend
features.entriesHtml:
You summon and form a bond with a wild or stray dog, which draws strength from your bottomless well of resilience using the Hound stat block.

The hound is Friendly [Attitude]|XPHB|Friendly to you and your allies and obeys your commands. It flees if you die.

The Hound in Combat.

In combat, the hound acts during your turn. It can move and use its Reaction|XPHB on its own, but the only action it takes is the Dodge action unless you take a Bonus Action|XPHB to command it to take an action in its stat block or some other action. You can also sacrifice one of your attacks when you take the Attack action to command the hound to take the Bite action. If you have the Incapacitated condition, the hound acts on its own and isn't limited to the Dodge action.

Restoring or Replacing the Hound.

If the hound died within the last hour, you can take a Magic action to touch it and expend 2 Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Points. The hound returns to life after 1 minute with all its Hit Points|XPHB restored.

Whenever you finish a Long Rest|XPHB, you can summon and bond with a new dog, which appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. If you already have a hound from this feature, the old one vanishes when the new one appears.

features.name: Dog and Hound
features.entriesHtml:
Fight Side by Side with a Brawler's Best Friend

Pugilists know what it's like to be an underdog, so it's no surprise some form a battleforged bond with a canine companion. They're used to being disappointed by friends that walk on two legs but a friend on four is as loyal as they come. When a fight breaks out, this duo's bite is even worse than its bark.

You share everything with your faithful hound: food, shelter, even moxie. When you use abilities granted by your Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2 feature, your hound gains a benefit as well.

Brace Up.

One-Two Punch.

When you use your One-Two Punch ability, your hound can make one or both attacks instead of you.

Stick and Move.

When you use your Stick and Move ability, your hound can take your choice of the Dash, Disengage, or Help action.

Additionally, whenever your hound hits with an attack roll and deals damage, it can deal your choice of Force damage or its normal damage type.

features.name: Black Magic
features.entriesHtml:
As a result of your relationship with your dread power, you gain the following benefits.

Two Cantrips.

You learn two cantrips of your choice from the Warlock spell list. Constitution is your spellcasting ability for your Black Magic spells.

Level 1 Spell.

Choose a level 1 spell from the Warlock spell list. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have.

Spell Change.

Whenever you gain a new level, you can replace one of the spells you chose with this feature with a different spell of the same level from the Warlock spell list.

features.name: Dread Hand
features.entriesHtml:
When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can manifest the evidence of your foul pledge to otherworldly powers. When you do, one of your limbs transmogrifies into a monstrous appearance reminiscent of your dread power and you gain the benefits below for 1 minute. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

Revenging Strike.

When you are hit by a melee attack, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to make an Unarmed Strike|XPHB against the creature that attacked you if it is within reach.

Unslakeable Bloodlust.

When you hit a target with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB, you can roll the attack's damage dice twice and use either roll against the target.

Whirlwind of Violence.

The first time you miss with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB each turn, you can reroll the attack and must use the new result.

Dread Powers.

A dread power can be any powerful malevolent entity capable of bestowing a portion of its power onto a mortal. Archdemons, Fey royalty, ancient liches, and unfathomable intelligences from beyond space and time are all possibilities.

features.name: Hand of Dread
features.entriesHtml:
Dabble With Dread Powers

In your darkest hour, you pleaded for the strength to take what you wanted from the world and a dread power took notice. At first, you may have relished the cathartic rush that came with channeling your eldritch might to claim what you felt you deserved, but this pact came with strings attached. In times of distress you hear the entity whispering in the back of your mind, urging you to indulge your most base impulses.

features.name: Deal with the Devil
features.entriesHtml:
You gain one of the following options of your choice. Whenever you finish a Long Rest|XPHB, you can change your choice.

Cloak of Shadows.

You can cast Invisibility once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

Mask of Many Faces.

You can cast Disguise Self without expending a spell slot.

Otherworldly Walk.

You can cast Misty Step once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in this way when you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

features.name: Grotesque Growth
features.entriesHtml:
When you use your Dread Hand|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|Hand of Dread|Pugilist2024|3 feature, you gain the benefits of the Enlarge effect of the Enlarge/Reduce spell and have a 10-foot reach.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB unless you take a level of Exhaustion (no action required by you) to restore your use of it.

features.name: Fountain of Viscera
features.entriesHtml:
You can take a Magic action and expend 6 Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Points to attempt to execute a creature of your choice within reach by magically burrowing your hand into its body and extracting its innards. The creature must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus). On a failure, the creature takes 100 Piercing damage. On a success, the creature takes 50 Piercing damage instead.

If this damage reduces the target to 0 Hit Points|XPHB, it immediately dies as you rip a hole through it, creating a stomach-turning fountain of viscera. When this happens, each creature of your choice within a 30-foot Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation originating from you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus) or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute. A creature that fails the saving throw can repeat the Wisdom saving throw again at the end of each of its turns, ending the Frightened condition on itself on a success.

Once you use this feature, you must finish a Long Rest|XPHB before you can use it again.

features.name: Bad Attitude
features.entriesHtml: You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill if you don't have it already. Additionally, you gain a bonus to checks using this skill equal to your Strength modifier (minimum bonus of +1).

features.name: Piss and Vinegar
features.entriesHtml:
Throw Barbs and Hands

Some Pugilists revel in their reputations as heels, happily playing up their bad behavior for notoriety. Despised by their enemies for their obscene curses and dirty tricks, these Pugilists take pride in their ability to provoke and willingness to win fights at any cost.

features.name: Salty Salute
features.entriesHtml:
You have mastered the art of the enraging insult. As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can provoke a creature within 60 feet that can see or hear you. That creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take Psychic damage equal to a roll of your Fisticuffs die plus your Constitution modifier and have Disadvantage|XPHB on any attack rolls it makes against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

The saving throw DC for this and all other features from this subclass equals 8 plus your Constitution modifier and Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Dirty Tricks
features.entriesHtml:
You have a few tricks up your sleeve to even the odds when the going gets tough. You can use one of the following Dirty Tricks. You can use one Dirty Trick each turn, and once you use a dirty trick, you can't use that trick again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

Heelstomper.

When you deal damage to a creature with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB or Pugilist weapon, the creature must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or its Speed|XPHB is reduced to 0 for one minute. An affected creature can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

Low Blow.

When you deal damage to a creature with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB or Pugilist weapon, you can hit the creature below the belt. When you do, the creature must succeed on a Strength saving throw or attacks against the creature have Advantage|XPHB until the end of your next turn.

Pocket Sand.

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you toss detritus into the eyes of a creature within 10 feet. The creature must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition until the end of its next turn.

features.name: Mean Old Cuss

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can choose a number of targets within 30 feet of yourself that can see or hear you up to your level in this class. Each chosen creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or take Psychic damage equal to a roll of your Fisticuffs die plus your Constitution modifier and have Disadvantage|XPHB on attack rolls it makes against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn.

features.name: Dirtier Tricks
features.entriesHtml:
You gain the following additional Dirty Tricks. You can use one Dirty Trick each turn, and once you use a dirty trick, you can't use that trick again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

Rabbit Punch.

When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB or a Pugilist weapon, you strike its head. Until the end of your next turn, the creature loses Resistance|XPHB to Psychic damage if it has it and has Disadvantage|XPHB on saving throws.

Sucker Punch.

When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB or Pugilist weapon, you can turn the hit into a Critical Hit|XPHB. For this Critical Hit|XPHB, you roll the attack's damage dice three times and add them together, instead of twice as normal.

features.name: Groundwork
features.entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Compression Lock.

When you start your turn with one or more creatures Grappled, you can deal Bludgeoning damage to each creature you have Grappled (no action required). The damage equals one roll of your Fisticuffs die plus your Strength modifier.

Inescapable.

When a creature makes a saving throw or ability check against your grapple or shove DC, you can expend 1 Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Point to give that roll Disadvantage|XPHB.

Stop and Drop.

When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB and don't use a mastery property as part of the attack, you can use both the Grapple and Shove option.

features.name: Muscle Mass
features.entriesHtml: Choose the Acrobatics or Athletics skill. If you lack proficiency with the chosen skill, you gain proficiency in it, and if you already have proficiency in it, you gain Expertise|XPHB in it.

features.name: Squared Circle
features.entriesHtml:
Drop and Lock Your Foes

Pugilists who fight in the Squared Circle know the fastest way to win a fight is to force a submission. These wrestlers focus on controlling their most powerful opponents with chokeholds and arm bars, forcing the enemy to fight on the Pugilist's terms.

features.name: Meat Shield
features.entriesHtml: While you have a creature Grappled, you gain Cover|XPHB|Half Cover against attacks made by creatures you aren't Grappling|XPHB. When a creature you aren't Grappling|XPHB misses you with an attack roll, you can take a Reaction|XPHB and expend 1 Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Point to force that creature make the same attack with a new attack roll against a creature you are Grappling|XPHB.

features.name: Heavyweight
features.entriesHtml: When you use the Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike|XPHB, you count as being one size larger. Additionally, you don't have to spend extra movement to move a creature Grappled by you if the creature is your size or smaller.

features.name: Clean Finish
features.entriesHtml:
When a creature ends its turn Grappled by you, you can take a Reaction|XPHB to force it to make a Constitution saving throw against your grapple's escape DC or have the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn. If the creature is Bloodied|XPHB and already Incapacitated by this feature, its Hit Points|XPHB are reduced to 0 instead.

Once you use this feature to reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points|XPHB, you can't use it again until you finish a Long Rest|XPHB.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.entriesHtml:
You can channel divine energy directly from the Outer Planes, using it to fuel magical effects. You start with two such effects: Fists of Faith and Grace of the Gods. Each time you use this subclass's Channel Divinity, you choose which effect from this subclass to create.

Once you use this subclass's Channel Divinity, you can't use it again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.

Fists of Faith.

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can imbue your fists with righteous fury. For the next minute, your Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes deal an extra 1d4 Radiant damage or 2d4 if the target is a Fiend or Undead.

Grace of the Gods.

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you beseech the gods for their grace. For the next minute, you have Resistance|XPHB to Necrotic damage and when you make a saving throw you can roll 1d4 and add it to the result.

features.name: Lay On Hands
features.entriesHtml:
Your blessed touch can heal wounds. You have a pool of healing power that replenishes when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. With that pool, you can restore a total number of Hit Points|XPHB equal to three times your Pugilist level.

As a Bonus Action|XPHB, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and draw power from the pool of healing to restore a number of Hit Points|XPHB to that creature, up to the maximum amount remaining in the pool.

You can also expend 5 Hit Points|XPHB from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don't also restore Hit Points|XPHB to the creature.

Devote Yourself to Prayer and Pummeling

features.name: Bare Knuckle Boxer
features.entriesHtml: Your attacks with Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes can score a Critical Hit|XPHB on a roll of 19 or 20 on the d20.
rawEntries: Your attacks with {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes} can score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB} on a roll of 19 or 20 on the {@dice d20}.

features.name: Cross Counter
features.entriesHtml:
You can block the brunt of an attack and launch one of your own in the same fluid motion. When you take damage from a melee attack, you can take a Reaction|XPHB and expend 1 Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Point to reduce the damage dealt to you by that attack by 1d10 plus your Strength modifier and Pugilist level.

If you reduce the damage to 0, you can make an Unarmed Strike|XPHB or attack with a Pugilist weapon against a creature within your reach as part of the same Reaction|XPHB.

features.name: Sweet Science
features.entriesHtml:
Float Like a Butterfly, Sting Like a Bee

Pugilists who practice the Sweet Science hit hard, fast, and often. These Pugilists sometimes battle for the entertainment of the upper classes, but just as often duke it out in back alleys and bars where their next breath depends on a knockout.

features.name: Combo Maker
features.entriesHtml: When you deal damage with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB against a creature, instead of also choosing the Grapple or Shove option with your Heavy Hitter|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|3|Pugilist2024, you can give yourself Advantage|XPHB on attack rolls you make against that target before the start of your next turn.

features.name: Combo Breaker
features.entriesHtml: When you use your Cross Counter|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|Sweet Science|Pugilist2024|3 and reduce the triggering damage to 0, you regain 1 Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Point.

features.name: Knock Out
features.entriesHtml:
You gain the following benefits.

Coldcock.

When you score a Critical Hit|XPHB against a creature, it must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, it has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

Uppercut.

When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike|XPHB you can take a Reaction|XPHB and expend 1 Moxie|Pugilist|Pugilist2024|2|Pugilist2024|Moxie Point to make the attack a Critical Hit|XPHB. Once you take this Reaction|XPHB, you can't do so again until you finish a Short Rest|XPHB|Short or Long Rest|XPHB.
